name: GatherMap v0.7.0 — Dark GUI
body:
## GatherMap v0.7.0 — Dark GUI

- Completely redesigned the settings interface with deep charcoal/arcane-blue panels, muted gold text and bronze borders.
- Replaced red Blizzard buttons with custom dark buttons and subtle hover feedback.
- Redesigned all three tabs: General, Node Tracking, Import / Export.
- Added compact dark checkboxes with green enabled indicators, cohesive input fields and scrollable lists.
- Improved General layout with two columns and better spacing.
- No change to resource recording, saved locations, pfQuest presets, icon-size controls or import/export functionality.
- Existing SavedVariables are preserved.

Compatible with Turtle WoW 1.18 (Vanilla 1.12 API).

Install: Extract the ZIP into Interface/AddOns, leaving a GatherMap folder. Back up your current folder and SavedVariables first.
